`check_config_status` correctly parses the gimprc `(key value)` format by stripping parentheses and splitting on whitespace, then checks items[0] == rule['key'] and items[-1] == rule['value'].
Expected value '50' precisely matches the instruction requirement (set minimum undo steps to 50).
Default initial `undo-levels` value in GIMP is 5, so the initial state does not trivially pass the evaluator - providing negative control resistance.
Single instruction requirement (undo-levels = 50) is fully and correctly verified by the evaluator.
